scope: Primary-source editorial records. Scores are editorial fit, not invented Steam reviews. Store-edition dates are not automatically original release dates.
records: A concentrated tour of tactile 3D stage design: movement toys and power-ups introduce a new physical idea before exhausting the old one. A first stop for the authored-course side of the genre.
PS5 game, not ASTRO's Playroom and not the older VR Rescue Mission. Hardware requirements and accessibility options should be checked on this exact product page.
A compact platforming introduction built around the PS5 controller. Especially useful as a low-commitment way to find out whether tactile, playful 3D traversal is your thing.
Included for PS5 owners, not a free PC download. A separate, smaller game from ASTRO BOT.
Terrain destruction changes how you read a 3D space: the route can be something you excavate rather than a path you merely follow. A major counterpoint to precision corridor platformers.
Switch 2 required. DK Island & Emerald Rush is additional content, not another full base-game entry or an automatic inclusion with every purchase.
An essential reference for expressive 3D movement, layered secrets and transformations that reinterpret a familiar landscape. The main route and completionist route serve different appetites.
Original Switch title; current Switch 2 enhancements do not turn its original release into a 2026 game. The second-player role is not a second full Mario campaign.

Two useful approaches in one edition: tightly authored cooperative 3D courses and a smaller connected playground in Bowser's Fury. A particularly strong comparison point for group-friendly level design.
The two adventures have different multiplayer structures. This is the 2021 enhanced package, not the original Wii U edition; read the mode-specific player requirements.
Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2

Gravity, curved surfaces and small planetary stages make this a valuable alternative to sprawling collectathons. The package preserves two distinct campaigns rather than pretending a bundle is a newly designed sequel.
Enhanced collection of older games. The listed 2025 date is this package's release; the constituent games and bundle are not counted again as three discoveries.

A strong modern 2D starting point where level transformations interrupt expectations and badges change the movement vocabulary. Optional challenges leave room to grow beyond the welcoming first impression.
Local cooperative play and online features are not identical. This record is the original Switch game; consult the exact edition before buying any later upgrade or package.

The route for players who want to study, create and exchange levels as well as finish them. Built-in courses offer an authored starting point before the quality and difficulty variability of user creations.
Nintendo Switch Online is required for relevant online sharing and multiplayer features. User-generated courses are not uniformly curated, accessible or balanced.
A priority pick for players who enjoy weighty momentum, elaborate moving environments and secrets that reward committing to a line. A good bridge from colorful presentation to demanding 2D execution.
This date is the Switch edition of an older game. Its friendly presentation should not be mistaken for uniformly easy late-game challenges.

Barrel routes, mine-cart timing and environmental spectacle make an important classic campaign available in a newer edition. Best considered alongside Tropical Freeze, not confused with Bananza's 3D destruction.
HD edition of the earlier Wii game, including additional stages from the 3DS version. The 2025 storefront release does not mean this is a wholly new original campaign.
A current discovery-led direction for Yoshi: observe and experiment with creatures inside a storybook rather than approaching every screen as a pure speed test.
Switch 2 required; this is a released 2026 game, not a speculative watchlist item. The official listing describes a single-player experience.
Handcrafted-looking dioramas, eggs and hidden-object searching make this a gentler exploration route. Useful for players who enjoy noticing details more than optimizing a movement combo.
The collection hunt and repeated stage perspectives are part of the experience; not the first choice for players seeking relentless precision difficulty.
Kirby and the Forgotten Land - Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World

Accessible 3D stages built around Kirby's changing abilities, with the expanded edition providing another reason to revisit its playful spaces. A good alternative to camera-demanding or punishing collectathons.
Enhanced edition of the 2022 original. This complete package and the separate upgrade pack are different purchases; the upgrade requires the base game. This edition requires Switch 2.
Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
A cooperative 2D adventure with copy abilities and an expanded supporting package. A sensible group choice when playful experimentation matters more than everyone performing perfectly.
Deluxe edition of an older campaign. Four-player local play does not imply four-player online campaign co-op; verify the mode you intend to use.

Fluid movement, ability-gated route design and tense encounters make a central console reference for the exploration-platformer branch. Best for players who want traversal and combat to reinforce each other.
Single-player, combat-heavy and not a gentle exploration walk. This is an action-exploration game, not a stage-by-stage Mario-style platformer.

A small free 3D experiment that translates Celeste's appetite for movement challenges into a compact anniversary playground. Worth trying for its concentrated traversal ideas rather than expecting a full commercial sequel.
Short standalone anniversary game. A recent page update is not its original release date; controller recommended by the creator. Sources and available builds are on the exact creator page.
A compact browser-playable look at the original mountain-climbing idea. Its small scale makes the movement loop easy to inspect without suggesting it replaces the later commercial Celeste.
PICO-8 original, not a free download of the full 2018 commercial game. Original date is left unspecified here rather than copied from a recent page update.
A concise grappling-focused variation that demonstrates how changing a movement tool can produce a different platforming language inside a tiny game.
Free PICO-8 anniversary game, not a numbered commercial Celeste sequel. Native host ratings, when available, retain their original five-point scale.
A free, open-source traditional platformer with a long-lived community and an included route into custom levels. A useful choice for exploring platforming without a store purchase.
Choose a stable build from the official download page; nightly builds and older ports have different compatibility. A new version number is not an original release date.
